name: Sophia
abilities: Aurelia: Ophanim Throne Judgment Dominion Grid
passives: Choir Edict: Aurelia gains Choir Resonance when controller play rewrites movement lanes, delays elite intent, and imprints safe/unsafe tiles on ordered sigil zones. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a radiant hierarchy judgment rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Radiant Hierarchies.
lore: Sophia, Wisdom of the Living Choir, is now canonized as one of the four playable god-Titans of Empyrean. The Titan is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: feminine divine wisdom, living ordinance, holy geometry, terrain law made compassionate. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology god whose behavior expresses feminine divine wisdom, living ordinance, holy geometry, terrain law made compassionate; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Empyrean canon.
visualDescription: Sophia manifests as feminine divine wisdom, living ordinance, holy geometry, terrain law made compassionate from Empyrean: beautiful serene feminine wisdom face, wide luminous eyes, soft lips, high brow, ancient calm; graceful feminine oracle frame, long neck, narrow waist, flowing hips, still commanding posture; signature silhouette: scroll ribbons, many-eye halo veil, compass staff, cathedral-curve silhouette. Weapon: glass compass staff and living scroll ribbons. Maintain the approved Titan Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Aurelia — Seraph Edict Lash Vector
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Empyrean source-culture damage at range 4; generate Momentum and a small Choir Resonance gain when used from edict-sung holy geometry or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as white-gold radiance, many-eye halos, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometries, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Titan into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Choir Seal Technique — Field Rewrite
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to moves enemies, rewrites terrain pressure, and delays high-threat actions through source-culture law. Builds Choir Resonance only when the player uses edict-sung holy geometry intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Aurelia: Ophanim Throne Judgment Dominion Grid
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Choir Resonance to impose a two-round rule from Radiant Hierarchies: moves enemies, rewrites terrain pressure, and delays high-threat actions through source-culture law. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Titan, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Seraphic Choir Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Choir Resonance, transform nearby terrain into edict-sung holy geometry, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Aurelia Compass Seraph Bell-Edict Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through edict-sung holy geometry. Visual: white-gold radiance, many-eye halos, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometries, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Aurelia Opal-Glass Cherubim Aegis
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Titan read as Radiant Hierarchies source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Aurelia Ophanim Many-Eye Choir Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Choir Resonance and unlocks a mastery branch for Archangel Herald Ascent, Ophanim Wheel Intercept, and Seal the Discord. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: reshape terrain and deny enemy plans
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Aurelia's Choir Edict: a solo mechanic where Choir Resonance grows through ordered sigil zones, reaction-window mastery, and controller decisions that rewrite movement lanes, delay elite intent, and imprint safe/unsafe tiles. Payoff: turn enemy pathing into objective tempo instead of raw crowd control. Counterplay: mobile enemies and line-of-sight denial reduce control value; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: mobile enemies and line-of-sight denial reduce control value
